messages.text: Hi. I’m looking for a world globe that I can put pins in to show the places I’ve visited.

That's a fun way to track your travels! I don't have a product in our catalog specifically described as a "push-pin" globe, so I can't promise a surface built for that — happy to double check with (email hidden) if you want to be sure before buying.

In the meantime, since you're browsing the kids' collection, is this globe for a child tracking their own trips, or more for yourself as a travel-memory piece?
This is for a child tracking their own trips

Got it — for a kid marking their own adventures, the 12" Interactive Talking World Globe with Wireless Intelli-Pen is a great fit: it's a raised-relief educational map, sturdy enough for a child's wear and tear, and lets them interact with the globe as they learn where they've been. I can't confirm the surface takes pins, so it's worth a quick email to (email hidden) to check before you decide on that part. You'll find it under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
You're welcome! Before you go — what almost made you look elsewhere, or is this pretty much exactly what you had in mind for them?
Exactly what I had in mind
That's great to hear — hope it brings them a lot of joy tracking their travels. If you have any other questions, I'm here!
